verdict.rationale: smolagents ships as a Python library with an extensively documented public API (guided_tour, reference/agents, tutorials/memory/tools) covering agent construction, execution (agent.run/agent.step/agent.replay), tool creation, memory access, and multi-agent orchestration, plus CLI utilities. This is exactly the kind of documented programmatic interface an AI-native user needs to drive the product. Missing for 10: no evidence of a REST/OpenAPI-style network API for smolagents itself (the openapi.json probe hit is for the HF Hub, not smolagents), and no independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness/stability beyond one community anecdote.
